> This notebook imposes the final PDF into signatures and saves the results as
> package files. Two versions are provided: `imposed_final.pdf` and
> `imposed_draft.pdf` which draws frames around each page.



Impose various PDFs with and without gutters between pages.


``` r
expand_grid(
  pdf_in = path(INST_PATH, "proofs", "final.pdf"),
  delta_x = seq(0, 6 * PAPER_THICKNESS, length.out = 4),
  frame = c(FALSE, TRUE)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pdf_out = path(
      INST_PATH,
      "proofs",
      "imposed_%s-gutter%i" |>
        sprintf(
          if_else(frame, "draft", "final"),
          as.integer(unclass(forcats::fct_inorder(as.character(delta_x)))) - 1L
        ),
      ext = "pdf"
    )
  ) |>
  pmap_lgl(function(pdf_in, delta_x = 0, frame = TRUE, pdf_out) {
    design_size <- pdf_in |>
      pdftools::pdf_pagesize() |>
      transmute(h = height / 72, w = width / 72) |>
      distinct()

    stock_size <- design_size |>
      transmute(
        h = h + TRIM_H,
        w = 2 * w + TRIM_W
        # w = 25 / 3
      )

    template <- ("
      \\documentclass[oneside]{article}
      \\usepackage{pdfpages}
      \\usepackage[
        letterpaper,
        layoutsize={%.6fin, %.6fin},
        layoutoffset={%.6fin, %.6fin},
        showcrop
      ]{geometry}
      \\begin{document}
      \\includepdf[
        pages={{}, -},
        signature = 16,
        landscape,
        openright,
        noautoscale,
        offset=-0.125in 0,
        delta=0 %.6fin,
        frame
      ]{%s}
      \\end{document}
    ") |>
      strsplit("\\n    ") |>
      unlist() |>
      paste(collapse = "\n") |>
      sprintf(
        stock_size$h, stock_size$w,
        (8.5 - stock_size$h) / 2, (11 - stock_size$w) / 2,
        delta_x,
        fs::path_real(path(INST_PATH, "proofs", "final.pdf"))
      )

    if (!frame) {
      template <- sub(",\n\\s*frame", "", template)
    }

    tmp_dir <- dir_create(file_temp("imposition_files_"))
    on.exit(unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE))

    write(template, path(tmp_dir, "imposed.tex"))
    with_dir(tmp_dir, system2("lualatex", "imposed.tex", stdout = FALSE))
    file_copy(
      path(tmp_dir, "imposed.pdf"),
      pdf_out,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    return(file_exists(pdf_out))
  }) |>
  all() |>
  stopifnot()
```

Interleave imposed documents with gutters to compensate for the width of the
folded signature. Innermost sheet in each signature will have no gutter;
outermost sheet will have a gutter equal to the thickness of six sheets of
paper.


``` r
tibble(
  pdf_path = dir_ls(path(INST_PATH, "proofs"), glob = "*-gutter*.pdf"),
  draft = grepl("draft", pdf_path),
  gutter_level = as.integer(sub("^.+gutter(\\d)\\.pdf$", "\\1", pdf_path)),
  page = map_int(pdf_path, pdftools::pdf_length) |>
    map(seq)
) |>
  unnest(page) |>
  filter(gutter_level == rep(rep(3:0, each = 2), 2)[page]) |>
  arrange(draft, page) |>
  summarise(
    .by = draft,
    body = "\\includepdf[pages={%i},noautoscale]{%s}" |>
      sprintf(page, pdf_path) |>
      paste(collapse = "\n")
  ) |>
  pmap_lgl(function(draft, body) {
    pdf_out <- path(INST_PATH, "proofs") |>
      path(if_else(draft, "imposed_draft", "imposed_final"), ext = "pdf")

    template <- ("
      \\documentclass[letterpaper,landscape,oneside]{article}
      \\usepackage{pdfpages}
      \\begin{document}
      %s
      \\end{document}
    ") |>
      strsplit("\\n\\s*") |>
      unlist() |>
      paste(collapse = "\n") |>
      sprintf(body)

    tmp_dir <- dir_create(file_temp("imposition_files_"))
    on.exit(unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE))

    write(template, path(tmp_dir, "imposed.tex"))
    with_dir(tmp_dir, system2("lualatex", "imposed.tex", stdout = FALSE))
    file_copy(
      path(tmp_dir, "imposed.pdf"),
      pdf_out,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    return(file_exists(pdf_out))
  }) |>
  all() |>
  stopifnot()
```
